summary: Scully Royalty Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 2, 2026, announcing the appointment of two new directors, Ho Kwun Cheong and Yu Chi Kong, to its board. Executive Chairman Michael Smith welcomed them, citing future benefit to the company. No stake, price, premium or transaction terms were disclosed. The appointments are ordinary board additions, not a forced or abrupt CEO/CFO departure, and there is no activist, takeover, divestiture or restructuring element. For risk-arb purposes, this is a non-event filing; no deal clock or overhang implications.
